svg.title: Pullback geodesics decode to straight lines
svg.desc: Left: the latent plane with a square grid, two endpoints, the straight latent segment (orange) and the pullback geodesic (blue), which is bent. Right: the images under a nonlinear bijective decoder; the grid is warped, the blue curve decodes to the straight chord between the two data points, and the latent straight line decodes to a longer curve.
svg.text: pullback geodesic γ* = f⁻¹(straight chord): bends in z, pullback length 5.523 = |x_b − x_a|
straight line in z: decodes to a curve, pullback length 5.562
